newsitem.title: BRUNEI: Brunei's finance minister quits, sultan takes job.
newsitem.headline: Brunei's finance minister quits, sultan takes job.

text.p: Brunei's Finance Minister Jefri Bolkiah resigned and his brother, the sultan of the tiny oil kingdom, will take over the job, an official statement said on Wednesday.
"The prime minister has announced that his majesty, the sultan, has accepted the resignation of his youngest brother Prince Jefri Bolkiah as the finance minister," the statement said.
"The prince has resigned from his post for personal reasons and on his own free will and will cease to be a member of the government of Brunei," the announcement said.
It said Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah, who is also the prime minister and defence minister, had assumed responsibility for the finance ministry from February 23.

It was on February 23, Brunei's National Day, that Sultan Hassanal announced a five-year development plan of BR$7.2 billion. The plan aims to diversify the kingdom's economy from its dependence on oil and gas by boosting non-oil exports.
